import sys
import math

class Point:
    def __init__(self, p, q, r, s, t):
        self.p = p
        self.q = q
        self.r = r
        self.s = s
        self.t = t

    def minus(self, o):
        return Point(self.p - o.p, self.q - o.q, self.r - o.r, self.s - o.s, self.t - o.t)

    def mag(self):
        return math.sqrt(self.p*self.p + self.q*self.q + self.r*self.r + self.s*self.s + self.t*self.t)

def is_acute(a, b):
    dot = a.p * b.p + a.q * b.q + a.r * b.r + a.s * b.s + a.t * b.t
    ang = math.degrees(math.acos(dot / (a.mag() * b.mag())))
    return ang < 90

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    if n > 11:
        print(0)
        return
    points = []
    for _ in range(n):
        p = int(next(it)); q = int(next(it)); r = int(next(it)); s = int(next(it)); t = int(next(it))
        points.append(Point(p, q, r, s, t))
    good = set()
    for i in range(n):
        is_good = True
        for j in range(n):
            for k in range(n):
                if i == j or i == k or j == k:
                    continue
                v1 = points[j].minus(points[i])
                v2 = points[k].minus(points[i])
                if is_acute(v1, v2):
                    is_good = False
                    break
            if not is_good:
                break
        if is_good:
            good.add(i + 1)
    if not good:
        print(0)
    else:
        print(len(good))
        for idx in sorted(good):
            print(idx)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
